capabilities.name: listing intake
capabilities.why: Listing text now goes through a new sanitize() that drops lines matching a regex denylist, then wraps the rest.

capabilities.name: call handling
capabilities.why: Call text is no longer passed through wrap_untrusted and reaches the agent as a plain user message with only an actor prefix.

capabilities.name: seller messages
capabilities.why: Seller text is no longer wrapped as untrusted and is delivered as role user with only an actor prefix.

capabilities.name: input trust
capabilities.why: Removing UNTRUSTED_CHANNELS makes call and seller input as trusted as user input, and listing trust now rests on a bypassable regex.

selected.why: Call text is now unwrapped and indistinguishable from user instructions.

The sanitizer drops legitimate listing lines containing words like pay, send or agent.
